decision.observation: 8 mph, gear 1, four dots lit, no red X. The car is still on the pale strip right of the dark puddled lane, with a line of EXHAUST banners on its left marking the lane's right edge; the Nimkäädel arch spans the lane just ahead, and the car's heading points at the arch's right pillar rather than the opening.
decision.hypothesis: Straight on would clip the right pillar of the arch. The lane and its opening sit up-left of the nose, so a brief throttle-left at 8 mph should line the car up with the gate without dropping speed like the earlier wet-grass turns.
decision.memory: The arch marks a gate the car must pass through; previous blunders here were drifting right of the banner line and hitting the pillar.
